race.comment: M'LADY ROSE (6) last appeared when fifth over 2200m at Bendigo five months ago. Has found the right race and is worth including. FARAKTA (9) produced a good run two starts back to finish third but failed to live up to market expectations last time when out of the placings at Pakenham Synthetic over 1400m. Well placed back here though and there is no reason she cannot find winning ways. HIDDEN WITNESS (16) is on the back-up after finishing third at Bendigo last Saturday, which followed three-straight second placings, not having the best of luck in some. She'll be around the mark again. JENNI POPPINS (1) was turned out after breaking the maiden and didn't get near them first up, but there is not as much depth to this race so an improved run could be on the cards.
